flow_summary: Interviewer handled the confused, disorganised patient well by rephrasing unclear or misread questions (especially PHQ-9/GAD-7 items) until answers were obtained and by consistently asking for additional entries on repeatable topics. Safety disclosure was managed with a proportionate protocol. A few transitions after safety instructions felt slightly abrupt, and questionnaire rephrasings occasionally bordered on mechanical.

issues.evidence: After the safety exchange ending with patient saying she could call her daughter, the next message immediately continued with the impairment question and GAD-7 without a brief pause or acknowledgment.
